title: Cayetano: Impeach drop is hitting a defense that can't strike back

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano on Tuesday likened the prosecution’s decision to withdraw three of the four articles of impeachment against Vice President Sara Duterte to a fistfight in which one party is hit but then told not to retaliate. “Kumbaga sa suntukan, sinuntok niyo na yung defense, then sasabihin niyo, ‘To save time, huwag na kayong gumanti,’” Cayetano said during the 39th day of the impeachment trial. (“It’s like a fistfight. You’ve already punched the defense, and then you tell them, ‘To save time, don’t hit back.’”) READ: Prosec drops all but unexplained wealth charge vs Duterte. Cayetano […]...
